name: Imouto Daisakusen ~Project i-mote~
source:
One day, you are told by your father that you have five younger half sisters, and they are wanting to see you. From tomorrow, they will come and see you singly day by day.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE026798.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有一天，你的父亲告诉你，你有五个同父异母的妹妹，她们想见你。从明天开始，他们会天天单独来看你。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE026798.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
